decisions: Chose Option 1 (full pluggable test toolchain) over Option 2 (testScope only, no toolchain file) and Option 3 (defer).
test-toolchain.json at project root declares scope-to-command mapping with size, timeout, requires, and baseline/profile composition.
testScope field added to features in feature_list.json — metadata for checker, not a replacement for verification string.
test-design skill separated from Java hardcode: strategy matrix stays language-agnostic, templates per framework (vitest/jest/junit/pytest/go).
Fully opt-in: no test-toolchain.json means current behavior unchanged.
Gate dependency DAG deferred — baseline is an ordered list, requires handles simple dependencies only.
acceptedRisks: Schema v1 will be hard to change once multiple projects adopt it — mitigated by opt-in and versioned schema.
requires field handles only simple dependency checks (binary on PATH, env var, scope ordering) — complex DAG deferred to a future feature.
